_comment: T-316, text on the run's end screens, read by the screens' scripts. time_up.headline: the time's up failure screen (HUD and menus, Content, 'Time's up screen'), shown for 3 seconds when the 8-minute timer runs out with the kaiju still alive. Text approved in the style loop (score 9). T-456 adds 'missions' (the notebook page) and 'power_ups' (the driving power-up overlay): HUD and menus, Content, 'Mission notebook and power-up texts'. Every entry scored 8 or more in the style loop (T-456's Style review).

missions.header_comment: The notebook page's header, at the top of the small pixel-art page on the left of the HUD that shows the current mission.

goals.extended_drift_comment: Notebook page goal line, a duration goal: one unbroken drift. {seconds} is the amount (no count).
goals.airtime_comment: Notebook page goal line, a duration goal: airtime in total. {seconds} is the amount (no count).
goals.alternate_drift_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: alternate drifts, for example 'Alt drifts 2/4'.
goals.three_sixty_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: ground 360s.
goals.air_one_eighty_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: air 180s.
goals.air_three_sixty_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: air 360s.
goals.thread_the_needle_comment: Notebook page goal line, a quantity goal: thread the needle.

power_ups.overlay_header: Mission done: soup up the car
power_ups.overlay_header_comment: The power-up overlay's header, opened when a mission completes; offers driving power-ups, not weapons.
power_ups.take_button_comment: The overlay's button that takes the chosen power-up.
power_ups.names_comment: Each power-up's name on its overlay card (the board's names, kept as the style loop scored them 9).

descriptions.rev_charge: Hold W+S {charge_seconds}s, let go of S: {boost_seconds}s boost. Brakes, now monetized.
descriptions.jump: Press Space to hop. Next hop in {cooldown_seconds} s. Airtime clips better than braking.
descriptions.bouncy_bumpers: Bounce {bounce_multiplier}x farther off walls and obstacles. Crashes are content too.
descriptions.rusty_overcoat: The car deals {contact_damage} damage to minions it touches. Rust: now a feature.

power_ups.descriptions_comment: One template per power-up, shown on its card for the tier offered; the slots are that tier's numbers from power_ups.json: charge_seconds and boost_seconds, cooldown_seconds, bounce_distance_multiplier (as bounce_multiplier), contact_damage.
